name: io.github.Solteris-Dev/pir-mcp
description: Motion sensor for AI agents: tells when a screen region changes or goes still. Scores, never pixels.

environmentVariables.name: PIR_CAPTURE_CMD
environmentVariables.description: Screenshot command template writing binary PPM to stdout; {x} {y} {w} {h} substituted. Default: grim (wlroots).

environmentVariables.name: PIR_SELECT_CMD
environmentVariables.description: Interactive rectangle selector printing 'x,y wxh'. Default: slurp. Empty disables the pick tools.

environmentVariables.name: PIR_WINDOW_GEOMETRY_CMD
environmentVariables.description: Prints 'x,y wxh' for window {id}. Default: Hyprland via jq. Empty disables window regions.

environmentVariables.name: PIR_PICK_WINDOW_CMD
environmentVariables.description: Interactive window pick printing the window id. Default: Hyprland + slurp.

environmentVariables.name: PIR_MAX_WAIT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Cap for blocking calls, ms (default 540000); keep under the host's MCP tool timeout.
